script.story_title_en: The friend at the gate at 3 am
script.logline_en: At 3 am Saro's father can't breathe; Saro is still on the phone to his school friend Vignesh when Vignesh's headlight is already at the gate, and by morning Saro realises he never even asked.
script.originality_note_en: A bank clerk drives his mechanic friend's own auto to hospital and pays the bill before being asked, and answers 'I never called you' with a joke about a slipping lungi that is the kural itself.
script.meaning_ta: ஆடை நழுவும் அந்த நொடியிலேயே, யாரும் சொல்லாமல் கை தானாக அதைப் பிடிக்கும். அதுபோல நண்பனுக்குத் துன்பம் வந்த உடனே, கேட்கப்படாமலே ஓடி வந்து அதை நீக்குவதுதான் நட்பு.
script.meaning_en: The moment a garment slips, the hand catches it on its own, without being told. Friendship is like that: it rushes in and clears a friend's trouble the moment it comes, without waiting to be asked.

cast.look_en: Lean build, long oval face, wheatish skin, short neatly side-parted black hair, thin black rectangular glasses, clean-shaven, calm eyes.
cast.outfit_en: Grey track pants, navy blue half-sleeve T-shirt with a blue-and-white checked shirt thrown on open over it, black rubber slippers, a silver wristwatch.
cast.voice_en: a calm, friendly, low and steady 29-year-old Tamil man's voice

cast.look_en: Stocky build, broad round face, dark skin, thick curly black hair, full short beard and moustache, a small scar through his left eyebrow, strong hands.
cast.outfit_en: Faded maroon sleeveless vest, a green-and-white checked lungi, a black thread on his right wrist, barefoot.
cast.voice_en: a husky, breathless 29-year-old Tamil man's voice

cast.look_en: Thin, elderly, short grey hair, grey stubble, deep lines on a kind face, dark skin, bony shoulders.
cast.outfit_en: A white cotton banian and a plain white veshti, a thin towel over one shoulder.
cast.voice_en: a weak, hoarse 62-year-old Tamil man's voice

locations.description_en: A narrow residential street in a Tamil Nadu town: Saro's small one-storey house with a sky-blue wall, a short green iron gate, a coconut tree by the wall, Saro's black-and-yellow auto parked beside the gate, a single yellow streetlight further down.
locations.light_en: 3 am, deep blue night; a warm bulb in the doorway behind Saro and the yellow streetlight; a white motorbike headlight from shot 1's second half on.
locations.blocking_en: Saro in the doorway, then at the gate on the left facing right; Vignesh arrives from the right on his motorbike and stands on the right facing Saro; the auto is parked at the left of the gate.

locations.description_en: A clean government-hospital corridor: pale green walls, a long row of steel bench seats on the left, a billing counter window with a steel grille at the far end, tall windows on the right, signs with no readable words.
locations.light_en: Cool white tube lights at night; from shot 7 first pale-orange dawn light comes in through the windows.
locations.blocking_en: Saro sits on the left end of the bench, Vignesh sits to his right; at the windows Saro stands left, Vignesh right.

locations.description_en: The front steps of the same hospital: wide stone steps, a neem tree, a small tea stall at the side with a steel kettle, an empty road beyond.
locations.light_en: Sunrise, low golden light from the right.
locations.blocking_en: The two walk down the steps towards the camera, Saro on the left, Vignesh on the right with his arm around Saro's shoulder.

props.description_en: Saro's old black smartphone with a cracked corner and a plain dark rubber cover, screen glowing.
A single auto-rickshaw key on a small brass ring with a red thread tassel.
Saro's black-and-yellow three-wheeler auto-rickshaw with a black canvas hood, a small plastic jasmine garland on the front, no writing.
Vignesh's plain dark-grey commuter motorbike with a round white headlight, no logos.
Two small white paper cups of milky tea, steaming.

hooks.narration_ta: ராத்திரி மூணு மணிக்கு கூப்பிட்டா, யார் வருவாங்க?
சரோ கூப்பிடவே இல்ல. ஆனா விக்னேஷ் வந்துட்டான்.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.narration_ta: சரோ இன்னும் பேசி முடிக்கல. அதுக்குள்ள, கேட்டுல ஒரு பைக் வெளிச்சம்.

segments.speaker: vignesh
segments.narration_ta: சாவியக் குடு. நீ அப்பா கூட இரு.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.narration_ta: விக்னேஷ் ஆட்டோ ஓட்டினான். பின்னால, அப்பாவ தாங்கிக்கிட்டு சரோ.

segments.speaker: vignesh
segments.narration_ta: லுங்கி நழுவுனா, கை பெர்மிஷன் கேட்டுட்டா பிடிக்குது?

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.narration_ta: உடுக்கை இழந்தவன் கைபோல ஆங்கே இடுக்கண் களைவதாம் நட்பு. ஆடை நழுவினா, கை கேக்காமலே பிடிக்கும். அதுதான் நட்பு.

shots.action_en: Saro, panicking, tells Vignesh on the phone that his father can't breathe; a headlight then sweeps over him.
shots.camera_en: Static medium close-up at eye level, slight handheld feel.
shots.image_prompt_en: Saro stands in the open doorway of his house at night, phone pressed to his right ear, eyes wide with panic, free hand gripping the door frame; the doorway bulb behind him, the dark street to the right.
shots.motion_prompt_en: Saro speaks urgently into the phone. After he finishes, a bright white motorbike headlight sweeps across his face from the street: Vignesh (lean, thin black rectangular glasses, short side-parted black hair, blue-and-white checked shirt open over a navy T-shirt, grey track pants) rides his plain dark-grey motorbike in from the right and keeps rolling slowly towards the gate until the clip ends; he never stops in frame. Saro lowers the phone a little, turns towards the gate and squints into the light, breathing hard. The rider is Vignesh, nobody else.

shots.action_en: The headlight reaches Saro before he has finished the call.
shots.image_prompt_en: Second cut from shot 1's clip (see shot 1).
shots.motion_prompt_en: Second cut from shot 1's clip (see shot 1).

shots.action_en: At the gate Vignesh holds out his hand for the auto key and tells Saro to stay with his father.
shots.camera_en: Medium two-shot from the street side, eye level.
shots.image_prompt_en: At the green gate at night, Vignesh stands on the right beside his motorbike, its headlight still on behind him, holding out his open palm towards Saro; Saro on the left clutches the auto key, looking at him.
shots.motion_prompt_en: Saro lets go of the key; Vignesh closes his hand around it and speaks to Saro, calm and quick; Saro nods. Exactly one key in the whole shot, in Vignesh's hand once Saro lets go; nobody holds anything else.

shots.action_en: Inside the moving auto at night: Vignesh drives; in the back Saro holds his father, who leans on him, eyes half-closed, breathing hard, a hand on his chest.
shots.camera_en: Medium shot from just in front of the auto, looking in at all three, eye level.
shots.image_prompt_en: Inside Saro's auto at night: Vignesh at the handlebar in front, eyes on the road; in the back seat Saro sits with his arm around his father, who leans his head on Saro's shoulder, eyes half-closed, one hand resting on his chest; Saro looks down at him, worried. Calm and gentle, nothing medical in view.
shots.motion_prompt_en: The auto moves down the empty night street; passing streetlights slide over their faces. The father breathes slowly and heavily, chest rising; Saro tightens his arm around him and rubs his shoulder; Vignesh glances back once, then forward. Nobody speaks.

shots.action_en: At the billing counter Vignesh pays before Saro has asked.
shots.camera_en: Medium shot from beside the counter window.
shots.image_prompt_en: Vignesh at the billing counter window with the steel grille, sliding a plain card and a folded form under the grille, glancing back down the corridor.
shots.motion_prompt_en: Vignesh slides the card under the grille, nods, and takes back a printed slip.

shots.action_en: On the bench Saro says he never even called him; Vignesh answers with a question about a slipping lungi.
shots.camera_en: Static medium two-shot, eye level, both faces in view.
shots.image_prompt_en: Saro and Vignesh side by side on the steel bench at night, Saro on the left, elbows on knees, tired, turning to Vignesh; Vignesh on the right, sitting back, looking at him.
shots.motion_prompt_en: Saro speaks first, voice cracking; then Vignesh answers with a small smile and a light shrug, miming a hand catching something; Saro laughs once through tired eyes.

shots.action_en: Dawn at the corridor windows: Vignesh hands Saro a cup of tea; the worst is over.
shots.camera_en: Medium wide shot from inside the corridor, the windows bright behind them.
shots.image_prompt_en: Saro and Vignesh standing at the tall corridor windows in pale-orange first light, Saro on the left, Vignesh on the right holding out a small paper cup of tea to him.
shots.motion_prompt_en: Saro and Vignesh stand at the corridor window at dawn, each already holding his own small steel tumbler from the first frame; they sip slowly and look out at the sunrise, shoulders relaxing; faint steam rises. Exactly two steel tumblers throughout: no cup is passed, added or removed. Nobody speaks; mouths stay closed except to sip.

shots.action_en: The two walk down the hospital steps in the sunrise, Vignesh's arm around Saro's shoulder.
shots.camera_en: Wide shot from the bottom of the steps, low angle.
shots.image_prompt_en: Saro and Vignesh walking down the wide stone steps towards the camera at sunrise, Vignesh's arm around Saro's shoulder, Saro tired but smiling.
shots.motion_prompt_en: They walk down two or three steps; Vignesh pats Saro's shoulder; the low sun flares behind them.

shots.action_en: Back to the night: Saro at the gate, the phone at his ear, as in the opening, so the replay flows into his call.
shots.image_prompt_en: Second cut from shot 1's clip (see shot 1).
shots.motion_prompt_en: Second cut from shot 1's clip (see shot 1).

script.loop_note_en: The last shot is the same doorway moment as the opening (the headlight reaching Saro), so the replay's first line, Saro's call to Vignesh, follows straight on from it.
